🆕 NEW RELEASE: Stand Atlantic release fifth album GODBREATH

Stand Atlantic's fifth studio album GODBREATH has been out since 23 October 2026 via Virgin Music Group. The 11-song record follows 2024's Was Here and was tracked live by the band. Velcro, LUCID, EDGE OF VEGAS and NEXT2U were shared as singles beforehand.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Bullet For My Valentine announce Social Apocalypse tour

The Social Apocalypse Tour 2027 covers 26 European arena shows between 21 January and 27 February 2027. Six dates are in Germany, from Düsseldorf on 27 January to Berlin on 17 February. Pendulum are special guests and Dark Divine open every night.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Silverstein and Beartooth join Vainstream Rockfest 2027

Silverstein and Beartooth are among the new acts for Vainstream Rockfest 2027 in Münster on 25 and 26 June. Both are listed for the Saturday, which is led by Architects and Dropkick Murphys. The Devil Wears Prada and Comeback Kid are on the same day's bill.
